result.topic_en: Linear substitutions of the variables u, w and the cogredient/contragredient variables ξ, x are composed with a further substitution, and it is noted that an invariant theory for these transformations again comes out entirely with a second-order differential operation symbol in the coefficients β.
result.transcription:
d.h.
$u_1 = \beta_{11} w_1 + \beta_{21} w_2$ | $\xi_1 = \beta_{11} x_1 + \beta_{12} x_2$
$u_2 = \beta_{12} w_1 + \beta_{22} w_2$ | $\xi_2 = \beta_{21} x_1 + \beta_{22} x_2$.
Wendet man nun noch eine Substitution an,
so
$w_1 = \gamma_{11} v_1 + \gamma_{21} v_2$ $\quad \mathfrak{T}_1 = \gamma_{11} \xi_1 + \gamma_{12} \xi_2$
$w_2 = \gamma_{12} v_1 + \gamma_{22} v_2$ $\quad \mathfrak{T}_2 = \gamma_{21} \xi_1 + \gamma_{22} \xi_2$
Man sieht daher, um einer Invariantentheo
für diese Transformationen aufzustellen
wiederum vollständig mit dem Operations=
symbol
$\mathfrak{R} = \frac{\partial^2}{\partial\beta_{12}\partial\beta_{12}} - \frac{\partial^2}{\partial\beta_{11}\beta_{12}}$
aus.
